exec: // First page of an availability search (searchCriteria + passengers). The Body tab is the request you send; edit it freely. This script only:
//   1. starts a new search: page 1, and clears availabilityId / availabilityResponseId / selectBookingClassIds of any earlier search,
//   3. at send time, drops passengers with count 0 and adds the return leg when {{tripType}} = RoundTrip (and the body has one leg).
// The saved body is not changed. Next pages are requested by CI_FlightNextAvailabilityRequest.
return value === undefined || value === null || value === "" ? fallback : value;
console.error("Availability body is not valid JSON after variables are replaced; it is sent as is.", e.message);
criteria.push({ origin: criteria[0].destination, destination: criteria[0].origin, date: pm.collectionVariables.get("returnDate") });
// A first page never names an earlier search.
pm.request.body.update({ mode: "raw", raw: JSON.stringify(body, null, 2), options: { raw: { language: "json" } } });
// Saves the page ids and picks, on every origin-destination, the first journey whose every segment offers {{bookingCode}}.
// Found: goes to CI_FlightSelectAvailabilityRequest. Not found: goes to CI_FlightNextAvailabilityRequest while hasMoreResults
// and page < {{maxPages}}, otherwise stops the run. Paging and stopping use setNextRequest, so they apply in the Collection Runner / Newman.
pm.test(`${label} response is JSON`, () => { throw new Error(e.message); });
// An error keeps the ids of the latest good page, so the search can still be paged or selected.
pm.test(`Booking code ${bookingCode} found on page ${page}`, () => true);
console.log(`Booking code ${bookingCode} not found for ${missing.join(", ") || "any origin-destination"} on page ${page}; requesting page ${page + 1}.`);
throw new Error(`Not found for ${missing.join(", ") || "any origin-destination"} after ${page} page(s) (hasMoreResults=${resp.hasMoreResults}, maxPages=${maxPages}).`);

exec: // Next page of the availability search started by CI_FlightAvailabilityRequest.
// The Body tab sends {{availabilityId}} + {{availabilityResponseId}} of the latest page; the Availability test scripts keep them up to date.
// This script only moves {{availabilityPage}} to the page being requested, and skips the call when there is no search to page.
console.error("No availability search to page: run CI_FlightAvailabilityRequest first.");
// Saves the page ids and picks, on every origin-destination, the first journey whose every segment offers {{bookingCode}}.
// Found: goes to CI_FlightSelectAvailabilityRequest. Not found: goes to CI_FlightNextAvailabilityRequest while hasMoreResults
// and page < {{maxPages}}, otherwise stops the run. Paging and stopping use setNextRequest, so they apply in the Collection Runner / Newman.
pm.test(`${label} response is JSON`, () => { throw new Error(e.message); });
// An error keeps the ids of the latest good page, so the search can still be paged or selected.
pm.test(`Booking code ${bookingCode} found on page ${page}`, () => true);
console.log(`Booking code ${bookingCode} not found for ${missing.join(", ") || "any origin-destination"} on page ${page}; requesting page ${page + 1}.`);
throw new Error(`Not found for ${missing.join(", ") || "any origin-destination"} after ${page} page(s) (hasMoreResults=${resp.hasMoreResults}, maxPages=${maxPages}).`);
